dynamicTools.name: desktop
dynamicTools.description: Read information exposed by the Lime desktop host.

tools.name: appInfo
tools.description: Read the desktop application name, version, locale, and platform.

dynamicTools.name: browser
dynamicTools.description: Operate the same Browser workspace tab that is visible to the user.

tools.name: openTabs
tools.description: List Browser tabs available to this conversation.

tools.name: newTab
tools.description: Open a new Agent-controlled tab in the visible Browser workspace.

tools.name: claimTab
tools.description: Claim an existing visible tab for the current turn.

tools.name: releaseTab
tools.description: Release Agent control while keeping a user tab visible.

tools.name: goto
tools.description: Navigate the claimed tab to an http or https URL.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Read the claimed tab URL, title, navigation state, and accessibility tree.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the claimed tab as a PNG image.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an actionable node from the latest observe result. Sensitive targets hand control to the user.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Replace text in an actionable field. Password or secret fields hand control to the user.

tools.name: press
tools.description: Press a non-submitting key in the claimed tab. Enter hands control to the user.

tools.name: markHandoff
tools.description: Keep the claimed tab for a later turn and release control when this turn ends.

tools.name: markDeliverable
tools.description: Keep the claimed tab as a user-visible deliverable when this turn ends.

tools.name: openArtifact
tools.description: Open a completed Browser download by its controlled artifact ref.

tools.name: revealArtifact
tools.description: Reveal a completed Browser download in the system file manager.

tools.name: copyArtifactRef
tools.description: Copy a controlled artifact ref to the system clipboard.

tools.name: readClipboard
tools.description: Read the system clipboard after turn-scoped approval.

tools.name: writeClipboard
tools.description: Write text to the system clipboard after turn-scoped approval.

tools.name: grantPermission
tools.description: Grant a pending Browser permission for this turn after explicit approval.

tools.name: uploadArtifact
tools.description: Upload a completed Browser artifact into the current file input after approval.
